title: Fragmented vulnerability tracking across pen tests and scanners
description: Security teams struggle to consolidate and standardize vulnerability data coming from disparate penetration tests and security scanners. Without a unified dashboard, managing remediation workflows and maintaining asset visibility across an organization becomes fragmented and overwhelming.
audience: DevSecOps Engineers, Cybersecurity Analysts, and CISOs

title: Lack of control over ad selection and formats in mobile apps
description: Mobile app developers using traditional programmatic ad networks face limited control over which ads appear, their visual formats, and exact display timing. This lack of fine-grained control can lead to poor user experience, irrelevant ad content, and lower monetization efficiency. Developers need solutions that enable direct ad selling and granular placement control.

title: Lack of privacy and transparency in mobile ad networks
description: Mobile app developers struggle with existing ad networks like AdMob and Unity Ads due to bloated SDKs, poor UX control, and privacy concerns. Unclear pricing models and low payout transparency further frustrate developers seeking fair monetization without compromising user experience.

title: Enforcing consistent coding standards across development teams
description: Ensuring every developer on a team adheres to the same coding guidelines and style rules is difficult and time-consuming. While linter tools exist, maintaining configuration consistency and seamlessly enforcing standards across multiple projects remains challenging.
audience: Software Developers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads
